checks: Each positive entry has an exact own-fiber parameter tending to zero. For each base the distinct marks allow a simultaneous disjoint union by the addition lemma. Comparison of convex combinations with their old marked points proves uniform Hausdorff closeness across the finite bases. Strict compatibility makes all these enlarged fibers actual at once and the global hull is precisely the hull of C and the positive apices.

For a negative mark, ambient uniqueness gives a strictly smaller maximum on each other original fiber. The restriction of the exposer to the own plane is nonconstant because a positive-volume fiber cannot have a unique maximizer for a constant function. Its hyperplane levels are Lebesgue-null, and every open slab strictly between minimum and maximum meets the fiber interior in positive volume. This makes cut mass continuous and strictly increasing near zero and gives the exact negative inverse.

Compactness and uniqueness imply the original removed pieces shrink to their marks. Distinct marks separate all these pieces, including distinct marks on one base. Strict gaps at all other marks and uniform locality of the positive changes ensure that simultaneous trims delete no positive added piece. No trim is required at a zero entry.

For every fixed positive homothety parameter less than one, the shrunken old fibers about their interior points have a strict slack in every exposing inequality. Finiteness lets all those homothets survive sufficiently small trims. They give positive volume and the inward Hausdorff estimate, while the enlarged fibers give the outward estimate.

The projection after trims contains P and is contained in conv(P), and is convex. Rehulling the surviving integer sections is contained in the trimmed convex body and includes each of those sections, so every section is exactly preserved. Base affine spanning and interior in one section already imply ambient full dimension.

A finite list of halfspaces with boundaries disjoint from the marks has strictly positive signed margins in absolute value at them. All localized pieces lie on their marks’ old sides even when each threshold changes by O(ε). Comparing at the same shifted threshold gives the stated exact signed change. Taking the whole space gives exact total mass.
